description: This file implements data structures and functions for managing a cache tree in Git, including functions for reading, writing, updating, invalidating, and verifying cache trees used internally by Git to handle object trees and index states.

classes.name: struct cache_tree
classes.description: Represents a cached object tree structure including its entries, subtrees, and associated object ID.

classes.name: struct cache_tree_sub
classes.description: Represents a subtree within a cache tree, including its name, associated cache tree, and usage flag.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cache_tree object.

methods.name: void cache_tree_free(struct cache_tree ** it_p)
methods.description: Frees a cache_tree object and its subtrees.

methods.name: int cache_tree_subtree_pos(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Finds the position of a subtree within a cache tree based on its path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * find_subtree(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen,int create)
methods.description: Finds or creates a subtree within a cache tree for a given path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * cache_tree_sub(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Returns the subtree for a given path within a cache tree.

methods.name: int do_invalidate_path(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Recursively invalidates cache tree entries along a specified path.

methods.name: void cache_tree_invalidate_path(struct index_state * istate,const char * path)
methods.description: Invalidates a path in the cache tree within the index state.

methods.name: int verify_cache(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and consistency of the cache tree and index.

methods.name: void discard_unused_subtrees(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Removes unused subtrees from a cache tree.

methods.name: int cache_tree_fully_valid(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Checks if a cache tree is fully valid and ready for use.

methods.name: int must_check_existence(const struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Determines if existence of a cache entry must be checked.

methods.name: int update_one(struct cache_tree * it,struct cache_entry ** cache,int entries,const char * base,int baselen,int * skip_count,int flags)
methods.description: Updates a cache tree node based on index cache entries, recreating the tree structure.

methods.name: int cache_tree_update(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Updates the cache tree based on the current index state.

methods.name: void write_one(struct strbuf * buffer,struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Serializes a cache tree node and its subtrees into a buffer.

methods.name: void cache_tree_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct cache_tree * root)
methods.description: Writes the entire cache tree into a buffer for storage.

methods.name: int parse_int(const char ** ptr,unsigned long * len_p,int * out)
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string buffer during reading.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * read_one(const char ** buffer,unsigned long * size_p)
methods.description: Deserializes a cache tree structure from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_read(const char * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Reads a cache tree from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_find(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Finds a subtree within a cache tree for a given path.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree_internal(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,int cache_tree_valid,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Internal function to write the current index as an object tree.

methods.name: struct:tree * write_in_core_index_as_tree(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Creates an in-memory tree object from the current index state.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,const char * index_path,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Public API to convert the index into a tree object, with optional prefix.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_sparse_dir(struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Initializes a cache tree for a sparse directory.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_rec(struct repository * r,struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * tree_path)
methods.description: Recursively primes the cache tree from an existing tree.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Constructs a cache tree from a tree object.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * find_cache_tree_from_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Finds the cache tree from traversal context.

methods.name: int cache_tree_matches_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct name_entry * ent,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Checks if cache tree matches a traversal entry.

methods.name: int verify_one_sparse(struct index_state * istate,struct strbuf * path,int pos)
methods.description: Verifies that a sparse directory is correctly represented in the cache.

methods.name: int verify_one(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct cache_tree * it,struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Verifies the consistency of a cache tree against index entries.

methods.name: int cache_tree_verify(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Performs verification of the cache tree structure for the index.

methods.description: unavailable
